sentences.en: Hello everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: I'm Jake Stevens and I'm your rep here at the hotel.
sentences.zh: 我是杰克·史蒂文斯，是本酒店的接待代表。

sentences.en: I'm sure you'll all have a great time here.
sentences.zh: 我相信各位在这里一定会度过一段非常愉快的时光。

sentences.en: So let me tell you a bit about what's on offer.
sentences.zh: 现在让我为大家简单介绍一下我们提供的各项服务。

sentences.en: I'll start by telling you about some of the excursions that are available for guests. /MT* One thing you have to do while you're here is go dolphin watching.
sentences.zh: 我先为大家介绍一些为住客安排的短途游览项目。/MT* 在此期间，您一定要体验海豚观赏之旅。

sentences.en: On our boat trips, we pretty well guarantee you'll see dolphins - if you don't you can repeat the trip free of charge.
sentences.zh: 乘坐我们的游船出海，几乎可以保证您看到海豚——若您未能见到，可免费重复参加一次该行程。

sentences.en: We organise daily trips for just 35 euros.
sentences.zh: 我们每天组织此类游船活动，每人仅需35欧元。

sentences.en: Unfortunately there aren't any places left for this.
sentences.zh: 很遗憾，今天下午的行程名额已满。

sentences.en: afternoon's trip, but come and see me to book for later in the week.
sentences.zh: 但欢迎您来找我预订本周晚些时候的行程。

sentences.en: If you're energetic, I'd recommend our forest walk.
sentences.zh: 如果您精力充沛，我推荐您参加森林徒步之旅。

sentences.en: It's a guided walk of about seven kilometres.
sentences.zh: 这是一次约七公里的有向导陪同的徒步活动。

sentences.en: There'll be a stop half way, and you'll be provided with a drink and sandwiches.
sentences.zh: 途中会在半程设一处休息点，届时将为您提供饮料和三明治。

sentences.en: There's some fairly steep climbs up the hills, so you need to be reasonably fit for this one, with good shoes, and bring waterproof in case it rains.
sentences.zh: 沿途有一些较为陡峭的山坡攀登路段，因此您需要具备一定的体能，穿着舒适的防滑鞋，并随身携带雨具以防下雨。

sentences.en: It's just 25 euros all inclusive, and it's every Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 该活动全包价仅为25欧元，每周三举行。

sentences.en: Then on Thursdays we organise a cycle trip, which will give you all the fun of biking without the effort.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们每周四还组织骑行之旅，让您尽享骑车之乐却无需费力。

sentences.en: We'll take you and your bike up to the top of Mount Larna, and leave you to bike back - it's a 700-metre drop in just 20 kilometres so this isn't really for inexperienced cyclists as you'll be going pretty fast.
sentences.zh: 我们将载着您和您的自行车抵达拉尔纳山山顶，随后您自行骑车下山——20公里内海拔下降700米，因此该活动并不适合缺乏经验的骑行者，因为下坡速度会相当快。

sentences.en: And if it's a clear day, you'll have fantastic views.
sentences.zh: 若天气晴朗，您还将欣赏到壮丽的风景。

sentences.en: On our local craft tour you can find out about the traditional activities in the island.
sentences.zh: 在本地手工艺之旅中，您可以了解岛上传统的手工艺活动。

sentences.en: And the best thing about this trip is that it's completely free.
sentences.zh: 此次旅行最棒之处在于完全免费。

sentences.en: You'll be taken to a factory where jewellery is made, and also a ceramics centre.
sentences.zh: 您将被带往一家珠宝制作工厂及一家陶瓷工艺中心。

sentences.en: If you want, you can buy some of the products but that's entirely up to you.
sentences.zh: 若您有意，也可购买部分产品，但这完全取决于您个人意愿。

sentences.en: The trip starts after lunch on Thursday, and you'll return by 6 pm.
sentences.zh: 该行程于周四午餐后出发，傍晚6点前返回。

sentences.en: If you're interested in astronomy you may already know that the island's one of the best places in the world to observe the night sky.
sentences.zh: 若您对天文学感兴趣，可能早已知晓：本岛是全球观测夜空的最佳地点之一。

sentences.en: We can offer trips to the observatory on Friday for those who are interested.
sentences.zh: 我们可为有兴趣的客人安排周五前往天文台的参观行程。

sentences.en: They cost 90 euros per person and you'll be shown the huge telescopes and have a talk from an expert, who'll explain all about how they work.
sentences.zh: 每人费用为90欧元，您将参观巨型望远镜，并聆听专家讲解其工作原理。

sentences.en: Afterwards we'll head down to Sunset Beach, where you can have a dip in the ocean if you want before we head off back to the hotel.
sentences.zh: 之后我们将前往日落海滩，若您愿意，可在返程回酒店前畅游大海。

sentences.en: Finally, there's horse riding.
sentences.zh: 最后是骑马活动。

sentences.en: This is organised by the Equestrian Centre over near Playa Cortino and it's a great experience if you're a keen horseback rider, or even if you've never been on a horse before.
sentences.zh: 该活动由邻近普拉亚科尔蒂诺的马术中心组织，无论您是资深骑手，还是初次接触骑马，都将是难忘的体验。

sentences.en: They take you down to the beach, and you can canter along the sand and through the waves.
sentences.zh: 他们将带您前往海滩，在沙滩上策马奔腾，甚至穿越浪花。

sentences.en: It costs t 35 euros and it's available every day.
sentences.zh: 每次活动收费35欧元，每日均可参加。

sentences.en: So there's plenty to do in the daytime, but what about night life?
sentences.zh: 因此白天的活动丰富多彩，那么夜间娱乐呢？

sentences.en: Well, the number one attraction's called 'Musical Favourites'.
sentences.zh: 首屈一指的夜间活动名为‘经典音乐剧之夜’。

sentences.en: Guests enjoy a three-course meal and unlimited free drinks, and watch a fantastic show, starting with musicals set in Paris and then crossing the Atlantic to Las Vegas and finally Copacabana.
sentences.zh: 宾客可享用三道式晚餐及无限量免费饮品，并观看一场精彩绝伦的演出——节目从巴黎背景的音乐剧开始，跨越大西洋来到拉斯维加斯，最终抵达科帕卡巴纳。

sentences.en: At the end the cast members come down from the stage, still in their stunning costumes, and you'll have.
sentences.zh: 演出结束后，全体演员将身着华美戏服走下舞台，您将有机会与他们交流。

sentences.en: a chance to chat with them t's hugely popular, so let me know now if you're interested because it's no good leaving it until the last minute.
sentences.zh: 该活动人气极高，因此若您有意参加，请务必立即告知我，切勿拖延至最后一刻。

sentences.en: It's on Friday night.
sentences.zh: 活动定于周五晚间举行。

sentences.en: Tickets are just 50 euros each, but for an extra 10 euros you can have a table right by the stage.
sentences.zh: 门票每张仅售50欧元；若额外加付10欧元，则可获赠紧邻舞台的座位。

sentences.en: If you'd like to go back in time, there's the Castle Feast on Saturday evening.
sentences.zh: 若您希望穿越时空，还可参加周六晚上的城堡盛宴。

sentences.en: It's held in a twelfth-century castle, and you eat in the great courtyard, with ladies in long gowns serving your food.
sentences.zh: 活动在一座建于12世纪的古堡内举行，您将在宏伟的庭院中用餐，身着长裙的侍女为您呈上佳肴。

sentences.en: You're given a whole chicken each, which you eat in the medieval way, using.
sentences.zh: 每位宾客将获赠一整只烤鸡，以中世纪传统方式——徒手取食。

sentences.en: your hands instead of cutlery, and you're entertained by competitions where the horseback riders attempt to knock one another off their horses.
sentences.zh: 用你的双手而不是餐具进餐，你还可以观看马背上的骑手们试图将彼此从马上掀下来的竞技比赛。

sentences.en: Then you can watch the dancers in the ballroom and join in as well if you want.
sentences.zh: 然后你可以观看舞厅里的舞者表演，如果愿意的话，也可以加入其中。

sentences.en: OK, so now if anyone ...
sentences.zh: 好的，那么现在如果有任何人……
